gay.definition:
s. full of or showing high-spirited merriment
s. given to social pleasures often including dissipation
s. offering fun and gaiety
s. homosexual or arousing homosexual desires
gay.translation: a. 欢快的, 艳丽的, 快乐的, 放荡的

examples.en: And if I were gay, would that be a crime?
examples.zh: 如果我是同志那又怎样？这能构成犯罪吗？

examples.en: I'll bet you a hundred dollars that Tom is gay.
examples.zh: 我和你赌一百元，汤姆是同性恋。

examples.en: I'm not gay, but I like to masturbate with other males.
examples.zh: 我不是同性恋，但是我喜欢和男的一起自慰。

general.definition:
n. a general officer of the highest rank
n. the head of a religious order or congregation
n. a fact about the whole (as opposed to particular)
v. command as a general
general.translation:
n. 一般, 将军, 大体
a. 全面的, 大体的, 总的, 一般的, 普遍的
n. 常规
[计] 常规

examples.en: The youngest siblings are in general the most beautiful ones.
examples.zh: 最小的兄弟姐妹一般都最漂亮。

examples.en: The general meeting began at 9 am on the dot.
examples.zh: 总会在九点整开始了。

examples.en: In general, men run faster than women.
examples.zh: 一般来说, 男人比女人跑得快。

generalization.definition: n. reasoning from detailed facts to general principles\nn. an idea or conclusion having general application\nn. (psychology) transfer of a response learned to one stimulus to a similar stimulus
generalization.translation: n. 一般化, 普遍化, 概括\n[化] 推广; 普适化

examples.en: The gamma function is a generalization of the factorial function.
The pitfalls of easy generalization are to be avoided.
Excessive generalization is a temptation for all original thinkers.

generally.definition: r. without distinction of one from others
generally.translation: adv. 通常, 逐渐地, 普遍地

examples.en: Generally speaking, nobles were only very slightly affected by taxes.
examples.zh: 总体来说，贵族受到税收的影响微乎其微。

examples.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
examples.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

examples.en: The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.
examples.zh: 阿尔卑斯山脉义大利一侧的海拔通常较低。

genetics.definition: n. the branch of biology that studies heredity and variation in organisms
genetics.translation: n. 遗传学\n[化] 遗传学

examples.zh: 我昨天见到的男人根本是绅士。

gently.definition: r. in a gradual manner\nr. in a gentle manner
gently.translation: adv. 温和地, 温柔地, 轻轻地, 逐渐地

examples.en: The leaves on the trees rustle gently in the wind.
examples.zh: 树叶在风中簌簌作响。

examples.en: The nurse gently put a bandage around my head.
examples.zh: 护士轻柔地给我的头缠上绷带。

examples.zh: 他把他的手温柔地放在她的肩上。

geographical.definition: a of or relating to the science of geography\na determined by geography
geographical.translation: a. 地理学的, 地理的

geometrical.definition: a of or relating to or determined by geometry\ns characterized by simple geometric forms in design and decoration
geometrical.translation: a. 几何学的, 几何的\n[机] 几何学的

glorify.definition: v. bestow glory upon\nv. cause to seem more splendid
glorify.translation: vt. 赞美, 美化, 赞扬, 使辉煌

glorious.definition: a. having or deserving or conferring glory\ns. having great beauty and splendor

examples.zh: 所以，为了荣耀上帝，你们要彼此接纳，就像基督接纳你们一样。

gnaw.definition: v. bite or chew on with the teeth

We all know dogs like to gnaw on bones.

goat.definition: n. any of numerous agile ruminants related to sheep but having a beard and straight horns
goat.translation: n. 山羊, 替罪羊, 色鬼

examples.zh: 羊屁股先生可没告诉我还有搭档。

goddess.translation: n. 女神, 美女, 受崇拜的女性

examples.zh: 帕查玛玛是安地斯山脉土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。

gold.definition:

golf.definition: n. a game played on a large open course with 9 or 18 holes; the object is use as few strokes as possible in playing all the holes\nv. play golf
golf.translation: n. 高尔夫球\nvi. 打高尔夫球

examples.en: He plays golf two or three times a month.
examples.zh: 他一个月玩两到三次高尔夫。

examples.en: They say that golf is very popular in Japan.
examples.zh: 他们说高尔夫在日本很流行。

examples.en: My son wants to become a professional golf player.
examples.zh: 我的儿子想成为一个专业高尔夫球手。

goodness.definition: n that which is pleasing or valuable or useful\nn moral excellence or admirableness

Tom did it out of the goodness of his heart.
Tom did that out of the goodness of his heart.

goose.definition:
n. web-footed long-necked typically gregarious migratory aquatic birds usually larger and less aquatic than ducks
n. flesh of a goose (domestic or wild)
v. pinch in the buttocks

gramme.definition: n a metric unit of weight equal to one thousandth of a kilogram

examples.zh: 爷爷叼着烟管跟我说话。

greeting.definition: n. (usually plural) an acknowledgment or expression of good will (especially on meeting)

examples.zh: 我向你们致以问候，愿我们之间的友谊带来和平。

grey.definition:
